executive_summary: All three specialists independently recommended HubSpot at 4/5 confidence. For a 40-person Dublin ad agency of account managers, media buyers and creatives, HubSpot uniquely combines the lowest adoption risk (3-7 days to competence, free Academy training, no admin headcount), the only natively integrated Meta/Google/LinkedIn ads tooling with ad-attributed revenue reporting, and mid-pack TCO (~EUR 48k year 1 vs ~EUR 110-160k Salesforce, ~EUR 32-40k Zoho with higher support/compliance friction). GDPR exposure is addressed by Frankfurt hosting selected at portal creation, a written TIA for US subprocessors, and quarterly data exports as an exit hedge.
reconciliation_notes: No vendor disagreement (HubSpot 3/3). Reconciled: (1) market-researcher's EUR 30-48k licence range vs risk-analyst's cost-creep warning -> costed concrete 20-paid/20-free seat mix plus 10% contingency, landing upper-middle of range; (2) Salesforce's stronger formal GDPR posture (low residual risk) vs HubSpot's low-medium -> judged marginal GDPR delta outweighed by Salesforce severity-4 adoption and lock-in risks, with HubSpot exposure mitigated cheaply; (3) training cost folded in at customer-discovery midpoint EUR 3,500, noting Salesforce's EUR 15-30k training burden erases Zoho's licence saving comparisons.
